titre: Capacités de vapocraquage annoncées à la fermeture en Europe
sous_titre: Milliers de tonnes d'éthylène par an, fermetures annoncées d'ici 2027

Sabic Geleen.texte: Sabic announced that its Olefins 6 cracker, capacity 865,000 mt/year, would stay closed

TotalEnergies Anvers.texte: TotalEnergies will shut its 580,000 mt/year Antwerp cracker by 2027

Dow Böhlen.texte: Dow Chemical on July 7 announced the closure of its 510,000 mt/year Bohlen cracker by the fourth quarter of 2027

Versalis Priolo.texte: closing its 450,000 mt/year Priolo cracker in 2027

Versalis Brindisi.texte: it would shut its Bríndisi 440,000 mt/year cracker by April 2027
